title: Database session factory and engine
description:
Create chatbot/db/__init__.py and chatbot/db/session.py.

Implement an async SQLAlchemy 2.0 session factory using sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio. The engine must read DATABASE_URL from os.environ (defaulting to postgresql+asyncpg://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/chatbot). Provide:
- An async create_async_engine() call scoped at module level
- An async_sessionmaker factory
- An async get_db() dependency generator suitable for FastAPI Depends()
- chatbot/db/__init__.py should re-export get_db and the session factory

Use sqlalchemy 2.0 style — no db-first patterns.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- This task document (task c.1)
- Any existing files in allowed_write_paths

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
